title: Jeff Galloway: The Marathon Is More Than a Time
excerpt: A January 2026 New York Times feature profiled Jeff Galloway, the 1972 Olympian behind the run-walk method, and his view of the marathon.
body:
Jeff Galloway, a 1972 US Olympian in the 10,000 meters and the coach behind the run-walk method, was the subject of a New York Times feature published on January 2, 2026, about his view of the marathon.

Galloway is best known for teaching planned walk breaks, an approach that has helped many recreational runners finish marathons and keep running for decades. His method puts sustainability and enjoyment ahead of finishing time.

Whatever pace you run, it's worth knowing why you keep coming back. Whether it's health, friendship, competition or time alone, that reason is the foundation of a training approach you can keep up for years.

Source: The New York Times
keyTakeaway: Know why you keep running; that reason is the foundation of training you can sustain.
